主要内容: Netflix, Inc. (NASDAQ: NFLX) announced it will release its third-quarter 2012 financial results and business outlook on its investor relations website on October 23, 2012, at approximately 1:05 p.m. Pacific Time. The company will issue a brief advisory release containing a link to the financial results and letter to shareholders. A live Q&A session will be hosted at 3:00 p.m. Pacific Time, with questions submitted via email. A live webcast and replay of the earnings call will be available on the investor relations section of the Netflix website. The dial-in number for the live call is (760) 666-3613, and the telephone replay will be available from October 23, 2012, through October 27, 2012. Netflix is the world's leading Internet subscription service for movies and TV programs, with over 27 million streaming members in the United States, Canada, Latin America, the United Kingdom, and Ireland.
